vote.rule: majority of the fifty per-record forest predictions
vote.tie_rule: np.bincount(...).argmax(), which returns the first position holding the maximum, so a tie goes to the lowest class index

mcnemar.correction: Edwards continuity correction, applied inside the chi-square approximation
mcnemar.family: none; one test, so no multiple-comparison correction applies

oracle_union.definition: a window counts correct if either model is correct; the prediction taken is that of whichever model was right, and the forest's when both or neither were
oracle_union.status: a ceiling that no deployable system reaches, reported to size the difference between the two models and nothing more

combiner.rule: take the sequence model's prediction whenever it names one of the five classes of PREREGISTRATION.md Amendment 6, and the forest's window vote otherwise
combiner.chosen_from: PREREGISTRATION.md Amendment 6, the five classes below F1 0.50 in the published run; chosen before anything here was measured
combiner.status: a post-hoc illustration of what the difference between the two models is worth; not a tuned model, and no hypothesis rests on it
